description: Canonical Bandwidth (ABMF) BINARY wire vectors. All multi-byte integers are LITTLE-ENDIAN; no version byte. Probe(53) = sequence u32 | sender_send_us i64 (12 B). Ack(54) = sequence u32 | sender_send_us i64 | receiver_receive_us i64 | receiver_send_us i64 | probe_bytes i32 (32 B); SenderReceiveUs is filled locally by the prober and is NOT on the wire. Gossip(55) = btlbw_bps i64 | rtprop_us i32 | confidence u8 (13 B); PeerUhid/TransportName/MeasuredAt are not carried in the body. Every language SDK MUST serialize to exactly these bytes (expected_hex is lowercase hex).
